summary: The strip shows a dark asteroid cluster against a starfield with steady drift and no pops or flicker, but the chase subject (two streaks, two silhouettes) is not visible.

faults.what: The shot is meant to be a chase with two streaks and two silhouettes, with the camera riding with him. The frames show only a dark asteroid blob, small tan rocks and stars. No character, streaks or chase subject is visible, and the main rock is nearly black against the dark blue sky.
faults.fix: Put the chaser and the chased in frame from the first frame of the shot, and light the asteroid rim so it reads as a shape.
